== Description ==
In this event, players complete by fighting normal PVP battles. Players earn points equal to the amount of damage done to enemy base (but not enemy units) when they win a battle (no points for a loss). Players may increase their points in this event by buying refills of Squad HP and/or Scans with Volt Coins.

This event comes also comes in a guild version (i.e. "Guild Overkill"). In the guild version the guild's points are the sum of all its player's points.
